label: 3D Swish
from: seamless packs 3D Rotation, Tilt and Flip
blurb: The picture turns fast in depth like a camera whip: it swings round an upright axis, tilts round a level axis or both, about a pivot behind it so it also sweeps across the frame, speeding up into the cut and slowing as the incoming picture turns into place, with motion blur that follows how fast each part moves, so the near edge streaks most. Bigger turns pass the edge-on moment quickly, hidden in the blur at the cut, so some picture stays readable. Seamless fills the plane with mirrored copies so no edge or background ever shows; turn it off to see a card turning in front of the background.
